approval.note: yerel test: transcript'te You'd better ve sat me down geçiyor (kısaltma/çekim farkı), yanlış pozitif

segments.text: For two years, I trained every single day, even when my body was begging me to stop.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker trained every day for two years despite physical exhaustion.
segments.turkishExplanation: İki yıl boyunca, vücudum durmam için yalvarırken bile her tek bir gün antrenman yaptım.

segments.text: Then, I caught a cold that turned into a chest infection, and I was stuck in bed for
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker caught a cold that developed into a chest infection, forcing bed rest.
segments.turkishExplanation: Sonra göğüs enfeksiyonuna çeviren bir soğuk algınlığına yakalandım ve yatağa bağlandım

segments.text: weeks. My coach sat me down.
segments.englishExplanation: After weeks in bed, the coach had a serious conversation with the speaker.
segments.turkishExplanation: haftalarca. Koçum beni karşısına alıp konuştu.

segments.text: It's time you took recovery seriously, she told me.
segments.englishExplanation: The coach advised taking recovery and rest seriously.
segments.turkishExplanation: "Dinlenmeyi ciddiye almanın zamanı geldi," dedi bana.

segments.text: You'd better schedule rest days, or you'll end up injured.
segments.englishExplanation: The coach warned that failing to schedule rest days would cause injury.
segments.turkishExplanation: "Dinlenme günleri planlasan iyi edersin, yoksa kendini sakatlanmış bulacaksın."

segments.text: I hated hearing it, but she was right.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker disliked the advice but acknowledged its truth.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bunu duymaktan nefret ettim ama haklıydı.

segments.text: Muscles get stronger while you rest, not only while you train.
segments.englishExplanation: Muscles strengthen during rest periods, not just active workouts.
segments.turkishExplanation: Kaslar sadece antrenman yaparken değil, dinlenirken de güçlenir.

segments.text: These days, I take two full days off every week.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker now takes two full days off training every week.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bugünlerde her hafta iki tam gün izin kullanıyorum.

segments.text: Sometimes, the hardest exercise is doing nothing at all.
segments.englishExplanation: The speaker reflects that resting can be harder than physical activity.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bazen en zor egzersiz hiçbir şey yapmamaktır.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to say that something should be done now, often implying it is slightly overdue. Even though it refers to the present or future, a past tense verb is used.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Şu an yapılması gereken (veya gecikmiş) bir eylemi belirtmek için kullanılır. Geniş veya gelecek zamandan bahsedilse de fiil geçmiş zamanda çekimlenir.
learningPoints.exampleEn: It's time you took a break.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: Used to give strong advice or warnings about what someone should do to avoid negative consequences.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Kötü bir sonuçtan kaçınmak için yapılması gereken güçlü tavsiye veya uyarıları ifade etmek için kullanılır.
learningPoints.exampleEn: You'd better leave now, or you'll miss the bus.
learningPoints.exampleTr: Şimdi çıksan iyi edersin, yoksa otobüsü kaçıracaksın.

quiz.question: In segment 5, what does the coach mean when she says "or you'll end up injured"?

options.text: You will eventually find yourself in an injured state as a result of not resting.
You will intentionally hurt yourself during your next training session.
You will recover much more slowly from your current chest infection.
You will immediately break a bone during your very next exercise.

issues.message: Learning point ifadesi ("had better") segment 5'in transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — pedagojik notation/çekim farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
"sit someone down" transcript metninde literal olarak bulunamadı — çekim/inflection farkı olabilir, yanlış pozitif olasılığı var.
